title: Operation Overlord - Normandy Campaign
description: D+1, 7 June 1944. The five Allied beachheads are ashore, the cross-Channel build-up is under way, and German formations are organizing local counterattacks. Consolidate the lodgment, secure the Cotentin and Caen, then break out across Normandy toward the Seine. Immediate command covers the Plymouth, Portland, Southampton, Portsmouth, and Bristol routes; Thames and North Sea staging remains outside the opening D+1 order network.

objectives.label: Hold the Normandy Lodgment
objectives.description: Keep Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno, and Sword under Allied control while the beach exits and follow-on routes are organized.

rewardEffects.label: The five beach supply routes are coordinated: +15,000 supply.

objectives.label: Secure Cherbourg
objectives.description: Advance through the Cotentin and capture Cherbourg so heavy supply can move through a deep-water port.

rewardEffects.label: Cherbourg naval capacity restored: +10 naval power.

objectives.label: Take Caen
objectives.description: Break the eastern counterattack and take the Caen road and rail hub to open the ground for an operational breakout.

objectives.label: Break the Saint-Lô Line
objectives.description: Take the Saint-Lô road junction and rupture the German defensive belt south of the lodgment.

rewardEffects.label: The Saint-Lô road net opens the breakout axis: +20,000 fuel.

objectives.label: Open the Avranches Corridor
objectives.description: Secure Avranches and open the route for the breakout from Normandy into Brittany and the French interior.

rewardEffects.label: The Avranches corridor supports mobile operations: +20,000 supply.

objectives.label: Take Falaise
objectives.description: Drive through Falaise to form the northern shoulder of an encirclement of the German armies in Normandy.

objectives.label: Take Argentan
objectives.description: Secure Argentan and close the southern shoulder of the Normandy encirclement.

objectives.label: Reach the Seine at Rouen
objectives.description: Pursue the retreating German armies and secure the Rouen crossing corridor on the Seine.

rewardEffects.label: The Seine crossing corridor is secured: +30,000 supply.

phases.label: D+1 Lodgment
phases.description: Hold all five beachheads and both airborne flanks while German local counterattacks gather.

phases.label: Normandy Expansion
phases.description: Drive through the Cotentin to Cherbourg and break the eastern defense around Caen.

phases.label: Operation Cobra
phases.description: Break the Saint-Lô line and open the Avranches corridor for mobile operations.

phases.label: Falaise Encirclement
phases.description: Close the Falaise-Argentan gap and trap the German armies remaining in Normandy.

phases.label: Pursuit to the Seine
phases.description: Pursue across northern France and secure the Seine crossing corridor at Rouen.
